meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 给你选定的 NanoClaw agent 装上真实电话号码工具:容器里多出 dial 命令,可发短信、打 AI 语音电话、收验证码。没被选中的 agent 调用会被网关拦下。
howto.when: 当你想让聊天里的 agent 发短信、打电话或执行 dial 命令,又不把 Dial 当作消息渠道时。需在 NanoClaw 仓库所在宿主机上运行,不能从聊天里跑。

say.text: 给 ag- 开头的这几个 agent 装上 Dial 工具
say.note: 它会先列出 agent 组让你挑选

say.text: 把 Dial 工具装给所有 agent
say.note: 之后每个 agent 都能发短信和打电话

say.text: 重新运行 add-dial-tool,只让 ag-xxx 用 Dial
say.note: 其余 agent 会被网关拦截

howto.what_en: Gives the NanoClaw agents you pick a real phone number tool: a `dial` CLI in their container, so they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and read verification codes. Agents you leave out are blocked at the gateway.
howto.when_en: Use when you want agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel. Run it from the NanoClaw repo on the host, not from a chat.

say_en.text: Install Dial for the agents starting with ag-
say_en.note: It first lists agent groups to choose from
Then every agent can text and call

say_en.text: Re-run add-dial-tool, keep Dial only for ag-xxx
say_en.note: Other agents are blocked at the gateway
